title: Grateful for the unwavering support on my mission for God! 🙏 Recently caught up with my amazing cell group and shared insights on how God detests gossip. Shoutout to my cousin Jeremiah Calo for the constant support, and huge thanks to Mayor Doctor Edward Chan for being a pillar in my ministries. The beautiful setting at Weegols Garden added a special touch. To my fellow soldiers of God, your prayers and encouragement mean the world. Let's keep spreading love and positivity! #MinistryMoments #Gratitude #GodsWork
